title: The 1980s Underground: Cassette Culture and Club Fekete Lyuk
grammar: Colloquial clipping, hypocoristics, and youth slang compounds (*-csi, -kó, uncsi, koli, pulcsi*)
goal: I can say how underground bands spread their music on cassettes in the 1980s and what the Fekete Lyuk club was.
I can recognise and use clipped words such as *koli*, *kazi* and *uncsi* in informal speech.
I can say that, according to accounts, the authorities watched the underground clubs.
